code.client:
// Claude Code 风格主题 —— JIMDB Agent 专用(claude-crew 生态)
// 作者:wangqiwang1(2026-10-20)
// 用途:crew dsh 默认 Martty 富 UI 连远程 dsh 角色子代理(lead/designer/coder/reviewer/tester)
//       时,把界面调成 Claude Code 观感:橙棕 brand(#D97757)+ 暖底深色 + 琥珀高亮。
// 激活:TUI 内 /theme → Claude Code;或 settings.json 的 tuiTheme 指定。
const palette = {
  "id": "claude-code",
  "label": "Claude Code",
  "dark": {
    "bg": "#1a1816",
    "surface": "#201d1a",
    "panel": "#26221e",
    "fg": "#e8e2d9",
    "fg_secondary": "#a89f92",
    "fg_tertiary": "#8a8175",
    "caption": "#7d7468",
    "brand": "#d97757",
    "brand_soft": "#c9a26d",
    "bubble_bg": "#e8e2d9",
    "bubble_fg": "#1a1816",
    "border": "#3d362f",
    "code_bg": "#141210",
    "ok": "#7fb069",
    "warn": "#d9a353",
    "err": "#e06c60",
    "hint": "#8ab4c9",
    "chip_bg": "#2b2723"
  },
  "light": {
    "bg": "#faf9f7",
    "surface": "#f1efeb",
    "panel": "#e8e5e0",
    "fg": "#2d2a26",
    "fg_secondary": "#6b645c",
    "fg_tertiary": "#8a8175",
    "caption": "#948b7f",
    "brand": "#c96342",
    "brand_soft": "#b08957",
    "bubble_bg": "#2d2a26",
    "bubble_fg": "#faf9f7",
    "border": "#d6d1c9",
    "code_bg": "#f1efeb",
    "ok": "#4d8f47",
    "warn": "#b58a2a",
    "err": "#cc4b40",
    "hint": "#3d7ea6",
    "chip_bg": "#e8e5e0"
  }
}

return {
  name: 'tui-theme-claude-code',
  inject: ['tuiTheme'],
  apply(ctx) {
    ctx.effect(() => ctx.tuiTheme.register(palette, { activate: false }))
  },
}
